caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bird decoy mounted on a long, straight stick. The bird is painted in a mix of brown, beige, and black colors, with a pattern of darker spots and areas of shading on its body and wings. The head is slightly bent forward, the beak is short and painted a reddish-brown color, and the eye is small and dark. The underside of the bird is lighter, with a beige or off-white color, while the back and wings are darker and mottled. The stick supporting the bird is long, straight, and appears to be made of natural wood, showing grain and slight curvature. The background is a plain, light cream color, and the drawing is centered on the page with no other objects present. The name "FRANKLIN SYRES" is printed in small, uppercase letters toward the lower right side of the image.
title: Decoy
